europe_now.title: Escalating Strikes and Casualties Reported in Ukraine Conflict
europe_now.summary: Heavy shelling in the Kherson region and a devastating missile strike on an aid center have resulted in numerous casualties, marking a sharp escalation following previous cease-fire periods.
